taskInterests.text: Make visual ideas clear and memorable.

salary.title: Graphic Designers
salary.label: Starting pay: TWC proxy · later pay: illustrations

assumptions.anchor: local occupation median for later illustrations; TWC lower-third proxy for entry when available
assumptions.upperBound: No modeled stage above the larger of the observed median and upper-quartile wage; absent an upper quartile, no stage above 1.20 × anchor.

sources.publisher: Texas Workforce Commission / Labor Market Information
sources.title: 2025 Annual MSA Wages · Entry wage proxy
sources.role: Mean wage of the lowest-paid one-third of workers in the selected occupation and location. It is an entry wage proxy, not observed pay by years of experience.

sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, via O*NET OnLine
sources.title: OEWS May 2025 · Austin metro
sources.role: Local wage anchor; all experience ratios are Fieldguide assumptions.

sources.title: How to use occupational wages
sources.role: Wage variation guidance; does not publish experience-year estimates.

notes: Mean wage of the lowest-paid one-third of workers in the selected occupation and location. It is an entry wage proxy, not observed pay by years of experience.
Models ordinary employee work in the same creative occupation. Excludes celebrity success, royalties, business revenue, and owner profit.
Figures hold purchasing power constant. No future inflation is added. Future labor-market conditions and personal outcomes can differ.
Entry means a first full-time qualified job after required preparation. Experience years begin there; education and apprenticeship years are separate.
